company_name: The University of Osaka, Sano Laboratory
semiconductor_relevance: High — The University of Osaka, Sano Laboratory focuses on advanced processing techniques for semiconductor substrates, particularly in the context of high-pressure plasma etching, which is critical for the fabrication of SiC and GaN devices.
summary: The University of Osaka, Sano Laboratory specializes in innovative processing methods for semiconductor substrates, emphasizing damage-free techniques using high-pressure plasma. Their research aims to enhance the efficiency and reliability of processing materials like SiC and GaN, which are challenging to work with using traditional grinding and polishing methods.
capabilities: High-pressure plasma etching for SiC and GaN substrates
Control technology for plasma ON/OFF switching
